title: Note 9 connects sony smartwatch 3 for xdrip collector
body:
Suddenly ssw3 cannot collects the bg for days.
I tried to unpair the ssw3 and re pairing with the phone and now xdrip plus does not installed on the ssw3. After some attempts of pairing it was installed on ssw3 but now it cannot collects the bg.
Would anyone please help?? If i try to collect the bg directly from phone it keep disconnects and cannot connects back.
